from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
source=Path('crates/logex-storage/src/durability.rs')
original=source.read_bytes()
try:
    text=original.decode()
    old='    sync_directory(parent(catalog))'
    assert text.count(old)==1
    text=text.replace(old,'    let file = File::open(catalog)?;\n    sync_file_and_directory(&file, catalog)',1)
    source.write_text(text)
    Path('/tmp/logex-catalog-file-sync-source.diff').write_text(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','crates/logex-storage'],text=True))
    import subprocess,json,pathlib,shutil
    for label,cwd in [('candidate','/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex')]:
     print('Building',label,flush=True)
     result=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--release','--test','ingestion_publication','--locked','--no-run','--message-format=json'],cwd=cwd,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
     pathlib.Path('/tmp/logex-catalog-file-sync-build-'+label+'.log').write_text(result.stderr)
     if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError(result.stderr)
     matches=[json.loads(line)['executable'] for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if json.loads(line).get('executable') and json.loads(line).get('target',{}).get('name')=='ingestion_publication']
     assert len(matches)==1,matches
     shutil.copy2(matches[0],'/tmp/logex-catalog-file-sync-'+label+'-bench')
     print(label,'built',flush=True)
finally:
    source.write_bytes(original)
